<!-- overview:start -->

## Overview

Publish CI-produced npm tarballs and finalize a GitHub release without rebuilding.
Call after successful CI on the prepared tag, passing its package-artifacts output.
See [the release guide](../../docs/usage/releases.md) for preparation, CI and recovery.

### Permissions

- **`actions`**: `read`
- **`contents`**: `write`
- **`id-token`**: `write`
- **`pull-requests`**: `read`

<!-- overview:end -->
<!-- inputs:start -->

## Inputs

### Workflow Call Inputs

| **Input**               | **Description**                                                                                                               | **Required** | **Type**    | **Default** |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------- | ----------- |
| **`package-artifacts`** | JSON package artifact list from successful CI in this same workflow run and at this release tag's commit.                     | **true**     | **string**  | -           |
| **`working-directory`** | Project directory relative to the caller repository root, matching release preparation and CI.                                | **false**    | **string**  | `.`         |
| **`ai-summary`**        | Generate an OpenAI summary before npm publication. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY; failures stop publication.                        | **false**    | **boolean** | `false`     |
| **`environment`**       | GitHub environment for AI and npm publishing. Configure npm trusted publishing for this environment and the calling workflow. | **false**    | **string**  | `release`   |

<!-- inputs:end -->
<!-- secrets:start -->

## Secrets

| **Secret**           | **Description**                                      | **Required** |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| **`OPENAI_API_KEY`** | OpenAI API key, required when ai-summary is enabled. | **false**    |

<!-- secrets:end -->
<!-- outputs:start -->

## Outputs

| **Output**        | **Description**                                                     |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`status`**      | published after all npm packages and GitHub release assets succeed. |
| **`tag`**         | Published release tag.                                              |
| **`release-url`** | Published GitHub release URL.                                       |

<!-- outputs:end -->
